Meta's Superintelligence Lab has released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, marking the company's first entry into frontier AI models.

Trained at the Prometheus data center in Ohio, the models feature an active memory property designed to retain and synthesize user information over extended periods.

Meta reports benchmark scores comparable to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra, with Wonder scoring particularly high on MemoryB…
